name: Bernauerhof
beschreibung: The family-run Hotel Bernauerhof is situated in the scenic Wildschönau valley in Tyrol. The hotel offers a variety of comfortable room categories, each featuring private en-suite bathroom facilities and most with balconies overlooking the mountains. On-site amenities include a welcoming restaurant serving traditional regional delicacies and a tranquil wellness area with a sauna. Catering equally to holidaymakers and business travellers, the surrounding region offers magnificent opportunities for hiking and skiing in the Ski Juwel area. On-site guest parking is conveniently available.
